title: Voice AI in Firms: A Natural Field Experiment on Automated Job Interviews
abstract: arXiv:2607.28222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study AI agents as information-collection technologies: automated systems that elicit decision-relevant signals from humans through live interactions. We test how such AI automation impacts information collection and organizational outcomes using a natural field experiment with 70,000 applicants applying for real jobs. Applicants were randomly assigned to be interviewed by either human recruiters or AI voice agents. Afterward, human recruiters evaluate the interviews and make hiring decisions. Applicants interviewed by AI agents are 12% more likely to receive job offers, and these gains translate into higher job starts and worker retention, with no decline in the productivity of hired workers. Analyzing interview transcripts reveals that AI voice agents achieve controlled variance: their interviews are more structured and consistent while remaining responsive to individual applicants, which is associated with more hiring-relevant

translated_title: 企业中的语音AI：关于自动化求职面试的实地自然实验
translated_abstract: 我们将AI智能体视为一种信息收集技术加以研究：即通过实时互动从人类身上获取与决策相关信号的自动化系统。我们利用一项涵盖70,000名真实职位申请者的大型自然实地实验，检验此类AI自动化如何影响信息收集与组织绩效。申请者被随机分配由人类招聘人员或AI语音智能体进行面试，随后由人类招聘人员对面试进行评估并做出录用决定。结果显示，由AI智能体面试的申请者获得工作录用的可能性高出12%，且这一优势转化为更高的入职率和员工留任率，同时被录用员工的生产力并未下降。对面试记录的分析表明，AI语音智能体实现了“受控的方差”：其面试更具结构性和一致性，同时仍能对每位申请者的个体情况做出回应，这与更多与招聘相关的
tldr: 一项涵盖7万名真实求职者的大规模实地实验发现，AI语音智能体进行自动化面试可使录用率提升12%，其核心机制在于AI实现了“受控方差”——面试更结构化、更一致的同时仍保持对个体的回应性，且不损害入职率、员工留任和生产力。
en_tdlr: A natural field experiment with 70,000 real job applicants shows that AI voice agents conducting automated interviews increase job offer rates by 12%, achieving "controlled variance"—more structured and consistent interviews that remain responsive to individuals—without reducing job starts, retention, or worker productivity.
